name: PMC-VQA
description: PMC-VQA is a large-scale medical visual question answering dataset containing 227,000 VQA pairs across 149,000 medical images spanning various modalities and diseases. It is designed to benchmark generative models that integrate complex visual and textual information for medical image interpretation.
reputation: PMC-VQA is a widely used medical VQA benchmark in the biomedical vision-language community, especially for evaluating generative models on medical image understanding.
notes: Includes a manually verified challenging test set and maintains a leaderboard for benchmarking generative MedVQA methods.
